customer_notes._comment: customer folder name -> client note folder in the vault, for the ones slug-prefix matching gets wrong

slack._comment: Enterprise Grid org ID (E…) for slack:// deep links; the workspace ID (T…) only resolved older channels. Channel IDs come from each client's Client Info note (Slack (internal) / Slack (external) rows, #name or link).

camera._comment: Insta360 Link Controller global shortcuts (Settings > Hotkeys, Global Shortcuts ticked per row). Every key below is pressed with these modifiers. Gimbal nudges use i/k/j/l, not arrows: ctrl+arrow combos trigger Mission Control even with cmd and option held.
camera.presets_comment: Link Controller preset numbering (verified on the device): Preset 1 = Meeting framing, Preset 2 = Whiteboard framing, regardless of the order the thumbnails show. Deck keys: Meeting -> Preset 1, Whiteboard -> Preset 2, Desk -> DeskView mode.

zoom._comment: Share Screen target as the Zoom plugin stores it (pick it once in the app's inspector to see the current value). A choice made in the app on any Share key wins over this on rescan.
